registrationReceived.noticePay: If you haven't paid yet, please complete the bank transfer within 24 hours to keep your spot.

newRegistration.footer: — SD Event | You're receiving this because new-registration emails are turned on in your team settings. A team admin can turn them off on the Team page.

teamInvitation.body: {inviter} invited you to join the team “{team}” on SD Event to manage event registrations and check-in together.

teamInvitation.footer: — SD Event | If you don't know the person who invited you, you can ignore this email.
